A '''mission''' to [[Obredaan]] was launched in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] in response to the failure of a [[First mission to Obredaan|previous mission]]. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] were assigned to rescue [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] from the Jin'ha. They then discovered the Jin'ha were [[Jin'ha cortosis mine|mining]] [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] and stole a sample before escaping.

==Prelude==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] fought [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Jin'ha]] warriors on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He defeated the arms dealers before they started a war on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] then [[First mission to Obredaan|sent]] two [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]], to [[Obredaan]] to investigate the Jin'ha. After contact was lost, the council then sent Kenobi and his master, [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]],<ref name="SW:OW" /> to rescue the two Jedi.<ref name="CSWE 1" />

==The mission==
Kenobi and Jinn fought through a group of Jin'ha warriors and [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] to find the wreckage of the Jedi's [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Obredaan)|spaceship]].<ref name="SW:OW" />

Kenobi and Jinn then infiltrated the Jin'ha [[Mining/Legends|mining]] camp. While Jinn rescued the two masters,<ref name="SW:OW" /> Kenobi discovered that the Jin'ha were mining cortosis<ref name="CSWE 1" /> and stole a sample of the metal, which was able to block the weapon of the Jedi, the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The four Jedi rendezvoused outside of the camp and defeated the remaining warriors. Plo Koon later revealed that he had noticed large-scaled production facility during his captivity.<ref name="SW:OW" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|What was that?''"<br />"''A Trade Federation gunship.''"<br />"''Well, what's it doing here?''"<br />"''I don't know.|Obi-wan Kenobi and Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="SW:OW" />}}
A [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Trade Federation gunship|gunship]] then flew overhead, suggesting to the Jedi a link between the Trade Federation and the Jin'ha. Kenobi and Jinn debriefed the Jedi Council, and Windu told them the Council would directly deal with the Jin'ha, as the implications of weapons able to combat the Jedi were disturbing. A few weeks later, the Trade Federation betrayed the Jedi Council's trust and [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockaded]] the planet of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SW:OW" /> Further investigation by Kenobi revealed that the Jin'ha were in fact mining cortosis for the Trade Federation.<ref name="CSWE 2">{{CSWECite|II|164|Jin'ha}}</ref> Jinn and Kenobi were assigned to secret negotiations with the Federation leadership.<ref name="SWE1">{{Film|I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The second mission to Obredaan appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]. The mission was later mentioned in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
